pages.text: Every drink does something, shown in its tooltip: $(item)Refreshed$() (hunger drains slower), $(item)Warmth$() (no freezing), $(item)Courage$() (less knockback), and a few of vanilla's. More stars, longer effects.
Refreshed, Warmth and Courage outlast a drink's alcohol by minutes: one now and then keeps them going without ever getting tipsy.
